snippet.title: Mejja - Mboka [Official Video]
snippet.description:
Mejja - Mboka [Official Video]
Mejja presents his 1st album: MTOTO WA KHADIJA. 
Known for his witty lyricism, street storytelling and unique Kenyan flavor, Mejja delivers a project that blends Genge, Hip Hop and Afro Urban sounds.
On this album, Mejja not only collaborates with established East African artists but also features new and uprising talents, giving a platform to the next generation of artists shaping the Kenyan music scene.
The album includes collaborations with Jay Melody, Nadia Mukami, Khaligraph Jones, Scar Mkadinali, Dyana Cods, Fik Fameica, Ndovu Kuu, Zzero Sufuri, Toxic Lyrikali, Shee, Moha and Madeh.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: ROSE MUHANDO - NJIA ILE (Official Video) SMS SKIZA 69815559 TO 811
snippet.description:
“Njia Ile” ni wimbo wa kiroho unaotukumbusha umuhimu wa kumjua Mungu na kusimama katika njia yake. Dunia ya leo imejaa mambo mengi yanayoweza kutuondoa kwenye uwepo wa Mungu, lakini wimbo huu unatukumbusha kwamba njia ya uzima ni nyembamba, na tunapaswa kuchagua kumfuata Mungu kwa moyo wote.

Kupitia sauti na ujumbe wake, Rose Muhando anatusisitizia tusipoteze muda mwingi katika mambo ya dunia na mitandao, bali tumtafute Mungu, tumjue zaidi na tuishi kwa kufuata mapenzi yake.

Take a look at Extended Gameplay for GTA 6, the latest entry in the third-person open-world action-adventure Grand Theft Auto franchise developed by Rockstar Games. Players will return to a modern-day Vice City as Jason and Lucia embark on a thrilling adventure full of action, consequence, and hilarity, signature to the franchise. Check out a suite of gameplay clips from missions, dialogue sequences, combat, and more, all captured on PlayStation 5. Grand Theft Auto 6 is launching on November 19 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6
